Name: All ML Features Composite
Description: Wide-row composite of all 22 Phase-2 ML features joined on the (symbol, date) key. ~70 columns covering return / vol / momentum / microstructure / options-implied / positioning / macro / regime dimensions in one row.

Name: On-Chain Dashboard Composite
Description: One-row composite view of network state and derived signals for BTC or ETH — mempool/gas, congestion composite, whale activity share, NVT, supply velocity, contract growth.

Name: Options Dashboard Composite
Description: One-row headline view of the day's volatility surface — ATM IV, IV-RV spread, term-structure contango flag, 25Δ skew, top pin strike, and DVOL — for the requested base currency.

Name: Per-Symbol Risk Panel
Description: One row per (symbol, date) summarizing the full risk view: realized vol (4 methods), ATM IV, IV-RV spread, drawdown depth + max, VaR at 95/99 confidence, and the cross-asset regime label.

Name: Daily New 52 Week Highs and Lows Counts
Description: Daily count of symbols making new 52-week highs vs new 52-week lows across the supported Binance universe.

Name: Advance/Decline Calculations
Description: Daily advance/decline counts and net A/D across the supported universe.

Name: Pair Counts Trading Above Moving Averages
Description: Daily counts and percentages of supported pairs trading above MA50, MA100, and MA200.

Name: Committment of Traders (COT) Timeseries
Description: Weekly CFTC Commitments-of-Traders positioning data — long / short / spread positions by trader category for the requested contract.

Name: Available COT Contract Names / Groups
Description: JSON array of CFTC Commitments-of-Traders contract names / asset groups exposed by the COT timeseries endpoint.

Name: Futures Basis Term Structure
Description: Daily basis (futures vs spot) for the requested base currency across the perp and quarterly contracts on Binance. Includes annualized carry % and days-to-expiry for each contract.

Name: Funding Regime
Description: Per-perpetual funding-rate regime: current funding, 7d/30d/90d averages, consecutive days of positive/negative funding, 1-year percentile, and a categorical regime label (e.g. extreme_negative, elevated_positive).

Name: Open-Interest Change
Description: Open-interest deltas at three horizons, paired with price change and categorical flags identifying whether the change reflects long_buildup, short_buildup, long_squeeze, or short_squeeze patterns.

Name: Perp Basis Time-Series
Description: Time-series-decomposed perp basis: current basis %, EWMA-smoothed values at 3d/7d/30d half-lives, and annualized carry.

Name: COT Positioning
Description: CFTC Commitment of Traders data for the requested category: money-manager net positioning, total open interest, net as % of OI, 5-year z-score, and categorical regime label.

Name: Real-Rate Regime
Description: 10-year real yield (TIPS-based) with 5d/30d/90d deltas, 5-year z-score, and a categorical regime label (very_low / low / neutral / high / very_high).

Name: Yield-Curve PCA
Description: Classic 3-factor decomposition of the US Treasury yield curve. PC1 explains parallel level shifts, PC2 captures slope (steepening/flattening), and PC3 captures curvature (humps/inversions).

Name: Macro Yield Spreads
Description: Treasury curve slopes and real-nominal spreads computed from the US Treasury par yield curve: 2s10s, 5s30s, 3m10y, plus real-nominal at the 5y and 10y points.

Name: Beta vs BTC
Description: Per-symbol rolling beta to BTCUSDT at 30/60/90/180 day windows, plus 30-day idiosyncratic return and 60-day R-squared. BTCUSDT itself is excluded.

Name: Large-Trade Share
Description: Fraction of daily notional that came from "large" trades, plus 7d/30d rolling averages and the 1-year percentile.

Name: Momentum Factor
Description: Classical academic momentum factors: returns over the past 12/6/3 months excluding the most recent month, plus their z-scores against the cross-section.

Name: Order-Flow Imbalance
Description: Daily order-flow imbalance for the symbol — buy volume share, sell volume share, raw OFI (buy − sell), and the 60-day z-score of OFI.

Name: Return Rank
Description: Where the symbol ranks against the top-30 universe on trailing returns at five horizons (1d/5d/20d/60d/180d). Returns both the cross-sectional z-score and the integer rank for each horizon.

Name: Reversal & Hurst Regime
Description: Short-horizon mean-reversion score (1d, 5d) plus a 60-day Hurst exponent and a categorical regime flag indicating trending vs mean-reverting behavior.

Name: Volatility Rank
Description: Where the symbol sits in the universe on 30-day realized vol — z-score and rank.

Name: Volume Profile
Description: Daily volume profile statistics: Point of Control (highest-volume price), Value Area High and Low (boundaries of the value area containing ~70% of volume), and the value-area percentage.

Name: Cross-Exchange Spread
Description: Daily price spread per pair across two venues — typically Binance (USDT) vs a USD-quoted venue (Bitstamp, Coinbase, etc.). Returns close prices, spread %, and 30-day rolling average.

Name: Address Velocity
Description: Daily active addresses on the chain with 7d/30d rolling averages, velocity ratios at multiple horizons, and a 90-day z-score. v1 is ETH-only — BTC requires unique-input/output address ingestion (deferred to Phase 2).

Name: ETH Contract Growth
Description: Daily count of newly-deployed Ethereum smart contracts with 7d/30d/90d rolling averages, 1-year z-score, and a categorical growth label.

Name: Network Congestion Score
Description: Cross-chain congestion composite that blends BTC mempool congestion, BTC fast-fee z-score, ETH fast-gas z-score, and ETH block utilization into a single score and categorical label.

Name: NVT Ratio
Description: Network Value to Transactions ratio per chain — market cap divided by on-chain transaction volume in USD. Returns raw NVT, 14-day smoothed NVT, and 180-day z-score.

Name: Supply Velocity
Description: How fast the circulating supply is changing hands on-chain. Velocity is the daily on-chain volume divided by circulating supply, with rolling averages, a 180-day z-score, and a categorical regime label.

Name: Whale Activity
Description: Daily share of on-chain transaction volume from large transactions (whale flows) per chain, with the 90-day z-score and a categorical whale flag.

Name: Implied Move
Description: Expected price move (% of spot) implied by the ATM straddle at three target maturities (7d / 30d / 90d). For each target DTE, also returns the actual available maturity and source strike used.

Name: Open-Interest Concentration
Description: Open-interest concentration metrics per maturity: Herfindahl-Hirschman Index, the top-3 strikes' share of total OI, and the strike with the most OI.

Name: Skew Signal
Description: 25-delta risk reversal per Deribit maturity (call IV − put IV at 25Δ), with 7-day and 30-day rolling averages, plus a categorical skew label per maturity.

Name: Smile Curvature
Description: Per-maturity IV smile descriptors: total smile width (wings minus ATM), wing asymmetry (put wing − call wing), and a kurtosis proxy capturing how peaked vs flat the smile is.

Name: Anomaly Score
Description: Per-symbol multivariate anomaly score using Mahalanobis distance from the rolling 90-day distribution of 5 features (log_return_1d, rv_30d, vol_ratio, funding_z, oi_change_5d). Higher distance = more anomalous today.

Name: Cluster Membership
Description: Universe-wide cluster assignments from K=6 hierarchical agglomerative clustering on the rolling 60-day correlation matrix. Returns one row per symbol with cluster_id, cluster_size, average intra-cluster correlation, and distance to cluster centroid.

Name: Regime State
Description: Per-symbol posterior probabilities across 3 regimes — trending up, trending down, and mean-reverting — from an EM-fit Gaussian mixture model. Plus a regime-transition flag when today's MAP regime differs from yesterday's.

Name: Spot Returns
Description: Per-symbol forward-looking and backward-looking returns at 1d, 5d, 20d, 60d horizons in both log and simple forms. 296 symbols covered.

Name: Spot VWAP
Description: Daily volume-weighted average price for the symbol, derived from the trade_summary silver. Constrained to the 9 symbols that have trade_summary partitions — broader spot universe is via the OHLCV endpoints.

Name: Aligned Cross-Venue Funding Rates
Description: All three venues' funding rates joined on 8h settlement buckets (00:00 / 08:00 / 16:00 UTC). Returns side-by-side venue columns plus median, max spread, and pairwise spread columns.

Name: Binance Funding Rates
Description: Raw 8h-cadence funding rate events for Binance USD-M perpetual contracts. Three rows per day (settlement at 00:00 / 08:00 / 16:00 UTC).

Name: Bybit Funding Rates
Description: Raw 8h-cadence funding rate events for Bybit USDT-margined linear perps. Same schema as the Binance endpoint.

Name: OKX Funding Rates
Description: Raw 8h-cadence funding rate events for OKX USDT-margined SWAP contracts. Uses OKX's `realizedRate` field (actual paid) over `fundingRate` (predicted).

Name: Available Binance Symbols
Description: JSON array of every Binance symbol across spot + USDT-perp + coin-perp + options (union view).

Name: Binance Futures CM Data
Description: OHLCV for Binance coin-margined (CM) inverse perpetual + dated futures.

Name: Binance Futures UM Data
Description: OHLCV for Binance USDT-margined (UM) perpetual + dated futures, selectable interval (`1d`, `1h`, `4h`, `1m`).

Name: Binance Options Data
Description: OHLCV option chains for Binance options — query by date, underlying, specific instrument, or maturity.
Key Parameters: underlying, symbol, type, maturity, enddate, limit, return

Name: Binance Spot Data
Description: OHLCV bars for Binance spot symbols at daily, hourly, or minute granularity — selectable via the `interval` parameter (`1d`, `1h`, `1m`).

Name: Binance Tick Data
Description: High-frequency aggregated tick bars for Binance — `unix_open` / `unix_close` window with per-window OHLC and trade counts.
Key Parameters: symbol, year, enddate, limit, interval, return

Name: DeriBit Futures Daily Data
Description: OHLCV for Deribit dated and perpetual futures.

Name: Available DeriBit Futures OHLC Symbols
Description: JSON array of every Deribit dated-futures contract symbol exposed by the futures OHLC endpoint.

Name: DeriBit Funding Data
Description: Deribit perpetual funding-rate history — 8-hour and 1-hour decay components, index and previous-index prices.

Name: Available DeriBit Funding Symbols
Description: JSON array of every Deribit perpetual symbol with stored funding-rate history.

Name: Deribit Options Timeseries
Description: Same as the single-instrument timeseries endpoint, kept under the newer canonical path. Returns OHLCV history for one Deribit option.
Key Parameters: currency, symbol, expiry, date, enddate, limit, offset, return

Name: Available Deribit Option Symbols
Description: JSON array of every Deribit option instrument name with stored OHLC history.

Name: DeriBit Volatility Data
Description: OHLCV history of Deribit's DVOL volatility index — the exchange's equivalent of the VIX, computed from listed Deribit options.

Name: BTC Mempool State
Description: Daily snapshot of the Bitcoin mempool from mempool.space: median fee (sat/vB), fast/slow confirmation fee tiers, mempool size in vBytes, pending block count, and a normalized congestion percentage.

Name: ETH Exchange Flows
Description: Daily net flow per exchange, derived from the day-over-day balance delta across labeled addresses. Returns total reserves both days, net flow in ETH and USD, addresses observed, and a status flag.

Name: ETH Exchange Reserves
Description: One row per labeled exchange wallet address with ETH balance (native and USD), role (hot/cold/deposit_aggregator), source attribution, and block number used for the snapshot. v1 universe: ~32 publicly-attested addresses across Binance/Coinbase/Kraken/Bybit/OKX.

Name: ETH Gas Prices
Description: Daily ETH gas-price snapshot from Etherscan V2 gas oracle (with Owlracle fallback): average / slow / fast gas in gwei, base fee, and priority fee.

Name: ETH Transaction Aggregates
Description: Daily Ethereum transaction-level aggregates from AWS Public Blockchain: transaction count, total ETH value moved, gas used, EIP-1559 ETH burned, unique sender/receiver address counts, and failed-tx count.

Name: Options Strike Heatmap (live)
Description: 2-D strike × expiry heatmap built from the latest `cdd-binance-options-iv` snapshot (every-minute producer in eu-west-1, ~1-min cache). Choose `metric=oi` (default) to see where dealer/customer interest is concentrated, `metric=iv` for the smile / surface, or `delta` to localise hedging-flow pressur

Name: Trading Correlations
Description: Pairwise rolling correlations between symbol pairs over the requested window and calculation method.

Name: Rolling Correlations
Description: Rolling pairwise Pearson correlations across the top-30 crypto universe — 435 unique (symbol_a, symbol_b) pairs at the requested window size.

Name: Drawdown Summary
Description: Drawdown summary for the requested symbol — all-time max drawdown %, current drawdown vs running peak, peak/trough dates, peak-to-trough duration, recovery time (peak-to-recovery), and an in-drawdown flag.

Name: Underwater Curve
Description: The complete daily underwater curve for the symbol — % drawdown from the running peak at every historical date, suitable for plotting an underwater chart.

Name: Market Regime Label
Description: Daily composite regime label across the cross-asset universe, derived from 5 z-scored components (breadth, vol, funding, COT positioning, IV). Returns a continuous regime_score in [−1, +1] plus a categorical label.

Name: Value at Risk (VaR)
Description: Per-symbol Value-at-Risk and Conditional VaR (Expected Shortfall) at the requested method (historical sim or parametric/Cornish-Fisher), expressed as a negative percentage return. Multiple confidence levels (90, 95, 99) and windows (30, 60, 90, 252) returned in one call.

Name: Portfolio Value at Risk
Description: Portfolio-level Value-at-Risk for one of two pre-built static portfolios (`cap_weighted_top10`, `eq_weighted_btc_eth_sol`), including portfolio VaR, per-symbol component VaR (decomposition of total risk), per-symbol marginal VaR (how much VaR changes per unit weight), and the symbol/weight arrays.

Name: Value at Risk by Symbol
Description: Worst-case observed loss per symbol with the date it occurred and the methodology used (parametric vs historical).

Name: Spot and Futures Prices & Corresponding Basis
Description: Aligned daily spot and futures OHLCV plus the resulting cross-market basis (spot − futures, or annualized carry for dated contracts).

Name: Binance Futures Funding Rates
Description: Historical funding-rate snapshots per Binance UM perp symbol — 8-hour settlements with the rate, calculated mark price, and timestamp.

Name: Available Binance Futures Funding Symbols
Description: JSON array of every Binance USDT-margined (UM) perpetual symbol that has stored funding-rate history.

Name: Binance Futures UM Summary Metrics
Description: Daily UM derivatives microstructure metrics — sum / count of open interest, top-trader long-short ratio, taker buy/sell volume ratio.

Name: Binance Options OI Totals
Description: Daily total open interest aggregated across all expiries — calls and puts separately, per underlying.

Name: Binance Options OI Totals by Instrument
Description: Per-instrument OI snapshot — start_OI vs end_OI for each option, with day-over-day delta plus volume and greeks.

Name: Binance Options OI Totals by Maturity
Description: Daily OI totals broken down by expiry — calls and puts separately.

Name: Binance Flow Imbalance (Order Flow Delta)
Description: Daily order-flow imbalance per symbol — delta between aggressive buy and sell volume, with raw and z-scored variants.

Name: Binance Large Trades (Whale Activity)
Description: Individual large trades on Binance spot — every print over the symbol's whale threshold, with side, price, quantity, and notional.
Key Parameters: symbol, market_type, startdate, enddate, min_usd, limit, offset, return

Name: Binance Spot Volume Summary
Description: Same daily spot trade-summary as the legacy endpoint with a wider symbol universe and longer history.

Name: Binance Trade Summary Available Dates
Description: JSON array of dates with stored Binance daily spot trade-summary records.

Name: Binance Daily Trade Summary
Description: Per-day Binance spot trade-summary at the symbol level — VWAP, buy/sell counts and volumes, average trade size.
Key Parameters: symbol, market_type, startdate, enddate, limit, offset, return

Name: Binance Hourly Trade Summary
Description: Per-hour Binance trade-summary aggregations — same shape as the daily summary but bucketed by hour.

Name: Binance Volume Profile (Price Distribution)
Description: Daily volume profile per symbol — volume traded at each price bucket, with POC, VAH, and VAL.

Name: BTC Market Capitalization
Description: BTC market cap timeseries — circulating supply × close price, sourced from blockchain.com.

Name: BCHAIN Aggregated Data
Description: Daily-aggregated blockchain.com series — transactions per day, mining difficulty, hash rate, mempool size, etc., per the BCHAIN code.

Name: Blockchain Summary Metrics
Description: Daily summary metrics for the BTC blockchain — transaction count, fee totals, miner revenue, average tx size, etc.

Name: On-Chain Ethereum (ETH) Summary Contract Creation Metrics
Description: Daily aggregate of ETH smart-contract deployments — total contracts, unique deployers, gas burned.

Name: Blockchain Transaction Metrics
Description: Daily BTC transaction-level aggregates — input/output sums, top transactions, fee distribution, and aggregate value moved.

Name: BTC Coin Creation(s)
Description: Per-day count of newly created BTC (coinbase rewards minted) and the per-block subsidy.

Name: Top 50 BTC Transactions per Day
Description: Daily ranked list of the 50 largest on-chain BTC transactions by output value.

Name: Deribit Options Flow Analysis
Description: Net options flow per day — aggressive buyer vs aggressive seller direction, broken down by underlying.

Name: DeriBit Greeks Summary by Instrument
Description: Instrument-level greeks summary — per (instrument, date) with maturity, strike, putcall flag plus volume and premium.
Key Parameters: underlying, symbol, startdate, enddate, limit, offset, return

Name: DeriBit Greeks Available Dates
Description: JSON array of dates with stored Deribit greeks summary records.

Name: Higher-Order Greeks
Description: Per-instrument vanna, charm, vomma, and speed for every listed Deribit option in the requested base currency, computed via scipy-free BSM central finite differences.

Name: DeriBit Greeks Summary by Maturity
Description: Greeks aggregated to the (underlying, maturity, putcall) level — useful for term-structure views of dealer positioning.
Key Parameters: underlying, expiry, startdate, enddate, limit, offset, return

Name: Deribit Options Large Trades Analysis
Description: Daily large-trade aggregations on Deribit options — count, total premium, and notional of prints over the dollar threshold.

Name: Pin Candidate Strikes
Description: Successor to the classic max-pain heuristic. Ranks Deribit option strikes by a composite of open interest, traded volume, and absolute gamma. Returns top 50 per (base_currency, date) with within-expiry and overall ranks.

Name: Deribit Options Put/Call Ratios
Description: Daily put/call volume and OI ratios per underlying.
Key Parameters: underlying, start_date, end_date, group_by, maturity, return

Name: Options Term Structure
Description: At-the-money implied volatility for every listed Deribit options maturity for the requested base currency and date, plus a contango/backwardation flag and the % deviation vs the 30-day ATM IV.

Name: Top 100 DeriBit Option Transactions per Day in USD
Description: Top 100 largest Deribit options transactions per (currency, date) ranked by USD premium.

Name: Deribit Options Volume Summary
Description: Per-day volume summary on Deribit options — total volume, total notional in USD, and trade count per underlying.
Key Parameters: underlying, start_date, end_date, group_by, maturity, return

Name: Funding Comparison (Legacy Daily)
Description: Daily aggregated funding rate per venue for the requested base currency, with annualized %, deviation from the cross-venue median, and the spread vs Binance. v1: 3 venues (Binance + Bybit + OKX) live from eu-west-1 hourly. Deribit funding pending.

Name: Options VWAP per Strike-Day
Description: Volume-weighted average price for each Deribit option strike × maturity × putcall combination traded on the requested date, with separate VWAPs in the base currency (BTC/ETH) and USD, plus volume and mean IV.

Name: Technical Analysis Indicators
Description: Per-symbol daily OHLCV with a battery of TA-Lib indicators pre-computed — ADX, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, Stochastic, ATR, and others.

Name: Deribit Options Transactions
Description: Raw individual transactions on Deribit options for the requested date and currency — every print with timestamp, instrument, price, size, side, and Greeks.
Key Parameters: underlying, date, symbol, putcall, min_usd_value, offset, limit, return

Name: Deribit Options Transactions Available
Description: JSON array of (currency, date) coverage objects indicating which dates the Deribit options transactions endpoint has stored prints for.

Name: Treasury Par Yield Curve Real Rates
Description: Daily US Treasury TIPS (real) yield curve — inflation-adjusted yields at the canonical maturities (5y, 7y, 10y, 20y, 30y).

Name: Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates
Description: Daily US Treasury par yield curve — nominal rates across the canonical maturity grid (1m, 2m, 3m, 6m, 1y, 2y, 3y, 5y, 7y, 10y, 20y, 30y).

Name: Volatility Cone
Description: Per-symbol realized volatility percentiles across {5, 10, 20, 30, 60, 90}-day windows and 4 RV estimators (close-to-close, Parkinson, Garman-Klass, Yang-Zhang), with each window's current RV positioned against its 2-year historical distribution.

Name: IV vs RV Spread
Description: Variance-risk-premium proxy: ATM 30-day implied vol minus 30-day realized vol (4 methods), with the spread expressed in % and a variance-risk-premium percentage. Also includes a rolling 30d average for context.

Name: Realized Volatility
Description: Daily realized vol estimates for the requested symbol across 4 estimators (close-to-close, Parkinson, Garman-Klass, Yang-Zhang) and 6 lookback windows (5, 10, 20, 30, 60, 90 days). 296 symbols covered.

Name: Implied Volatility Surface
Description: Daily IV surface grid — 9 moneyness × ~13 maturities — smoothed via Nadaraya-Watson kernel regression. Each row is one (strike, DTE, moneyness) cell with both the raw IV and the kernel-smoothed value.

Name: Black Scholes Merton (BSM) Option Pricing Model
Description: On-demand BSM option-pricing calculator — returns theoretical price plus full first- and second-order greeks for the provided parameters.
Key Parameters: putcall, strike, spot, rfr, days_to_maturity, buysell, iv, price
